SELECT a.code_module, AVG(sa.score) FROM studentAssessment sa JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment = a.id_assessment JOIN studentInfo si ON sa.id_student = si.id_student AND a.code_module = si.code_module AND a.code_presentation = si.code_presentation WHERE (si.final_result = 'Pass' OR si.final_result = 'Distinction') AND a.assessment_type = 'TMA' GROUP BY a.code_module;
